recorded_by.impersonation_disclaimer: Not the owner. The decision below was given by the owner in person and is transcript-bound.

decision.question: after the sealed v2.2 ledger bytes were lost, run the rehearsal again as a new series or pause P4.2a

reviewer_requirements_for_the_series_2_d: a preregistration amendment that records the loss by citing a7cea63, carries the lost series' digest chain as history, and defines series 2 with a fresh series token under DISCLOSED_REPEATABLE_SERIES_V1; gates, thresholds, samples, seeds, models, prompts, contracts and gold stay byte-identical

an explicit epoch-origin rule so a fresh ledger whose first attempt binds the current landed epoch can build and validate its bundle; the [2,4]-only special case and the sealed-bundle recovery machinery of the unlanded epoch-5 candidates are not required and should not be landed unless the design shows a concrete need

a visible, unmistakably named ledger location outside any directory used for disk cleanup, registered in the implementation constants, plus a seal-time byte-exact copy of every attempt to a second location the owner designates, verified by digest
the smallest implementation epoch that achieves the above on top of the currently landed registered bytes, with F-12 and the persistent gate unchanged

ordering: the cninfo capacity change lands first as an independent production fix; the series-2 epoch lands next; from that landing until release nothing touches any control-surface member; the reverted backup-retention fix re-lands only after release
